title: Local Green Forms and Chow Correspondences: Constructions and Geometric Transfer
subtitle: Constructions and geometric transfer
summary: Proofs of the actual obstruction, finite trace, rational-fibre rigidity, numerical descent and Chow covariance, with algebraic-equivalence and abelian-motivic applications in their stated geometric scope.

1.1. How the local construction is assembled

The curvature construction precedes the support construction. Model Chern forms and the numerical detector are developed in Section 3. The restricted trace in Section 4 then handles original scalar–curvature generators; its one-parameter formula recovers the scalar potential without expanding its domain to arbitrary actual forms. In Section 5, supported perfect complexes and finite-flat multisections produce the prescribed residue and exact-open Green pair. The proof assembled in [1, Theorem 1.1] supplies the model-Chern and trace interfaces and derives (A1) by producing global primitives for generic Chow-zero characters. It establishes (A1) and (A2) for smooth integral projective KKK-varieties, without requiring geometric integrality or good reduction. The remaining source-image vanishing is the issue addressed by the geometric reductions.

These operations are applied in two ways. Section 6 constructs primitives from compact additive families. Section 7 constructs them from semistable numerical certificates and traces the original generator expressions along composite finite maps. Finally, Section 8 transports certificates by algebraic intersection theory on regular models and proves the product consequences.

abstractHtml: We develop two geometric constructions for actual non-Archimedean Green forms. The Chow obstruction and curved Green pairs on prescribed support complements are established in the companion construction theorem. Algebraically trivial classes are treated through additive Poincaré families, rational-fibre rigidity and compactness of ppp-adic abelian groups. Homologically trivial classes on abelian varieties are treated through vertical corrections on semistable models. Finite numerical descent and Chow-kernel covariance transport this vanishing to classes with a supplied Chow retraction. We include the model Chern forms, scalar–curvature finite trace, exact-support Green pairs, compact-parameter primitives, abelian numerical descent and regular-model correspondence argument, and identify the full projective-bundle and smooth-immersion results needed for general Chow covariance. Products of curves and abelian varieties follow; vanishing for an arbitrary homologically trivial class remains a separate problem.
